name: us2-adopt-unbound-parent
description: 003 US2 (T088): a story-labelled candidate exists but its spec's feature-level ticket is neither already bound nor bound in this run (no ticket carries the feature label). Adopting the story alone would leave an orphan under a parent the bridge does not own, so the binding refuses with `unbound-parent` and points at the --bind that fixes it. Exit 4 (FR-014).
